# Introduction to Thermodynamics

Thermodynamics describes the relationships between
heat, work, temperature and internal energy.

## The First Law of Thermodynamics

The first law expresses conservation of energy:

$$
\Delta U = Q - W
$$

where:

- $U$ is the internal energy.
- $Q$ is heat transferred into the system.
- $W$ is work done by the system.

## Worked Example

A gas absorbs 500 J of heat and performs
200 J of work.

The change in internal energy is:

$$
\Delta U = 500 - 200 = 300\ \mathrm{J}
$$
